description: HTTP framework for V with its own HTTP/1.1 engine: router with :params, middleware chain, first-party WebSocket, strict request framing (Content-Length and chunked, smuggling-hardened, fuzzed in CI). Tuned: one SO_REUSEPORT epoll loop per CPU (epoll_cores) instead of the default thread-per-connection I/O. json-comp uses viltrum's gzip middleware.
